scope: Exact set accounting for gates of the same supplied scalar DAG; polynomial consequence of one global joint remainder bound.

gate_set_semantics.G: Final reachable ordinary +/* gates of the fixed graph.
gate_set_semantics.P: Actually constructed scalar coefficient prefix B -> C, in the same graph.
gate_set_semantics.J: card(G \ P): all joint fusion/normalization/sign/spectral gates remaining in that graph.

bounds.exact_partition: card(G) = card(G intersect P) + card(G \ P)
bounds.family_constants: K and d are fixed outside the quantifier over n.
